home.hero_desc_1: Our farm started its journey in 2019 in West Surabaya under the name 4 Putra Parrot. Initially, we focused on breeding Lovebirds. However, as our experience grew and our understanding of parrot characteristics deepened, we confidently expanded into breeding various parrot species.
home.hero_desc_2: We maintained this consistency until we successfully developed large parrots such as the Blue & Gold Macaw and other Macaw variants.
home.hero_desc_3: In 2025, we changed our breeding business name to PT 4 Putra Vertex Aviary. This change signifies our seriousness in legally breeding parrots.
home.popular_desc: Discover our favorite parrot collections, from the agile Sun Conure to the majestic Macaw, all captive-bred, tame, and ready to be your new companion.
footer.slogan: Making every customer feel valued - no matter the size of your audience

achievements.hero_desc_1: 4Putra Vertex Aviary had the opportunity to hold an educational exhibition at Dinamika University. It was not just a visual exhibition; we presented an interactive experience where students could interact directly with our exotic collection, from cheerful Galah to majestic Macaws.
achievements.hero_desc_2: This activity is a tangible manifestation of our commitment to not only be breeders, but also educators. We share insights about the unique characteristics of curved-beak birds, the importance of animal welfare, and the legality of keeping exotic animals in Indonesia.
achievements.page_desc: Milestones and the track record of PT 4Putra Vertex Aviary.
achievements2.hero_welcome: SOCIALIZATION RELATED TO PARROT BREEDING, PARROT HEALTH, AND OTHER MATTERS CONCERNING PARROTS AMONG RESIDENTS OF
achievements2.hero_desc_1: 4Putra Vertex Aviary greeted the residents of Dungus Village, Gresik, through a casual conversation full of knowledge. We did not come alone, but brought along a young licensed veterinarian to provide valid medical explanations directly to the residents.
achievements2.hero_desc_2: This activity is our way of “kulonuwun” (paying respects) and building trust with the local villagers. We want to alleviate their concerns with facts, starting from a thorough explanation of hygienic cage design, proper waste disposal procedures, to expert explanations that our birds are safe from infectious diseases. In essence, we want to prove that breeding businesses can coexist harmoniously and safely with residential areas.
about.hero_desc_1: Our journey began in 2019 under the name 4Putra Exotic Parrots. As our business grew and our commitment to professionalism deepened, we transformed our identity and legal status into PT 4Putra Vertex Aviary. This change in business structure underscores our seriousness in delivering higher and more reliable standards of aviculture management in the West Surabaya area.
about.hero_desc_2: We combine the practical experience we have built since 2019 with a modern management approach. Our main focus includes the conservation and breeding of exotic species such as Macaws, Afgreys, and various other types of parrots. Our team consists of dedicated professionals who ensure that each animal receives precise nutrition and a hygienic living environment.
about.hero_desc_3: Animal welfare is always our top priority in every aspect of our operations. Therefore, our facilities are equipped with modern hatching technology to support the success of our breeding program. We have successfully bred species such as Blue & Gold Macaws, African Greys, and Sun Conures independently. As a guarantee of quality and legal compliance, each bird we breed is fitted with a closed ring to ensure data validity and ease of pedigree tracking.
about.team_desc: 4Putra Vertex Aviary is managed by a team of dedicated professionals committed to aviculture excellence.
contact.hero_desc_1: Want to visit or ask about our bird collection? Our team is ready to help you.
